videos.script: A running process is not the same as a working one. A server can be up, holding its port, and answering every request with an error. {{running}} The kubelet can only tell the difference if you give it a question to ask. That question is a probe, and there are three of them, each with a different consequence. {{three}} Readiness asks: should this pod get traffic now? A no takes it out of the Service, and nothing else. {{readiness}} Liveness asks: is this process still worth keeping? A no restarts the container. {{liveness}} And startup asks: has it finished starting? Until it has, the other two wait. {{startup}} You will make the shop fail each question on purpose, and watch exactly what the cluster does about it. {{watch}}
